# Chanko

> Japanese Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Savory pancakes layered with yakisoba noodles, plus curry, katsu and portions that turn into tomorrow's lunch.

- Phone: (813) 770-7306
- Address: 4603 N Florida Ave, Tampa, FL 33603
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country, Gibsonton
- Offers: Hiroshima okonomiyaki; Chicken katsu; Plates and curry
- Rating: 4.7 from 1587 Google reviews
